title: Tick Phase
description: Checklist with a phase-coloured tinted-ring tick marker and a divider between items, for the individual service pages (the marker and divider follow the page's phase via --ls-phase-accent). Typography and text colour live here; the list reset, item layout, divider and the ::before tick marker are in src/scss/structural/tick-phase.scss because a content:"" pseudo-element and descendant <li> rules have no block-supports equivalent. Unlike Tick Accent, which is a solid brand-coloured circle.
